title: Normalized social item definition (legacy social_items domain)
description: Contract for one normalized social item: one stored legacy social_items entry. The stored integer id is the stable identity, so legacy_id is its decimal form (rule S2); native amounts and display strings are kept verbatim (rule S1), including the uniformly-empty description which is preserved with a manifest note, never defaulted. See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored social_items id preserved verbatim as a string (rule S2): the decimal form of the native integer id.

kind.description: Classification of the stored social_items domain: every entry maps to social_item.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets social_items).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets social_items).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Native stored social item id, kept verbatim (rule S1).

workers.description: Hireable-worker display names, preserved verbatim as display data, never parsed as references or behavior (rule S1).

worker_cost.description: Native stored worker cost, kept verbatim (rule S1).

description.description: Social item description, preserved verbatim; empty in all stored entries, kept with a manifest note and never defaulted (rule S1).
